sourcePrompt: <any non-empty text — the extension replaces this with the verbatim change description before validation>

intent.objective: <primary objective as interpreted from the prompt>
intent.expectedOutcome: <expected end state if the objective is achieved>
successIndicators: <observable indicator that the outcome was achieved>

inferences.evidence: <prompt text / repository fact / artifact entry supporting it>

outOfScope.item: <item with evidence that it is out of scope>

undetermined: <item whose scope is not decided — do NOT classify it out of scope>

ambiguities.question: <unresolved question or ambiguous statement>
ambiguities.impact: <impact if the wrong interpretation is chosen>

summary.narrative: <concise summary of the interpreted intent and important conclusions>
clarificationsNeeded: <decision or clarification required from the user>
